title: Online Falsehoods in Recent News Reports Alleging Singapore's Involvement in 1MDB Deals
what_it_is: Online Falsehoods in Recent News Reports Alleging Singapore's Involvement in 1MDB Deals

sections.label: Minister for Law on online falsehood
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister for Law for the Ministry's views on alleged online falsehoods about Singapore and 1MDB.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Law what is the Ministry's views on the deliberate online falsehood appearing in recent news reports published in States Times Review, China Press and elsewhere alleging that Singapore is involved in corrupt 1MDB deals.

sections.label: STR conspiracy theory on 1MDB
sections.summary: STR added a twist, concocting a conspiracy theory that the Prime Minister and Government corruptly allowed 1MDB money laundering for favourable terms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: This time, however, STR added a malicious twist.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: It took the old points on the agreements and concocted a conspiracy theory about how our Prime Minister and the Singapore Government corruptly allowed money laundering of 1Malaysia Development Berhad (1MDB) funds in exchange for terms favouring Singapore.

sections.label: MAS penalties and asset seizures
sections.summary: BSI Bank was fined S$13.3 million, eight other banks around S$29.1 million, and S$240 million in assets was seized.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: BSI Bank was also hit with a financial penalty of S$13.3 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: MAS also imposed financial penalties totalling around S$29.1 million on eight other banks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: MAS also worked to bring wrongdoers to justice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: It seized assets amounting to S$240 million, of which S$120 million belonged to Jho Low and his immediate family.

sections.label: MAS police report against STR
sections.summary: MAS lodged a Police report on the STR article, and action will follow Police investigations and AGC advice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: That is the evidence of Mr Ben Nimmo, when he came before the Select Committee.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Now, turning to the Government's response, on the evening of 8 November, MAS lodged a Police report in relation to the STR article.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Action will be taken against the wrongdoers, based on the outcome of Police investigations and on the advice of AGC.

sections.label: IMDA takedown and block of STR
sections.summary: IMDA requested STR take down the article on 9 November and directed Internet Service Providers to block the STR website.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) issued a request to STR on 9 November to take down the article.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: IMDA proceeded to direct the Internet Service Providers to block the STR website, and they have since done so.

sections.label: Facebook failure to remove falsehood
sections.summary: A question asks if social media giants would act differently under an independent body, while Facebook has not removed the falsehood.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
sentences.text: Two, a more general question, dealing with the social media giants, does the hon Senior Minister of State think the attitude of these giants would be different if the direction were made by an independent body, for example, the judiciary, instead of a Government agency?

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: I reiterate that we have been disappointed with Facebook's failure to remove the clear falsehood.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: The Sarawak Report itself, having seen the STR version of the article, published a very clear statement, not once but twice, calling out the STR report as being "false", "erroneous" and "misleading".

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: Despite that, Facebook has not seen fit to remove its content or block the STR Facebook page.

sections.label: PA grassroots accounts consolidation
sections.summary: PA consolidated all 1,800 grassroots accounts into its financial statements and has received an unqualified audit opinion since 2013.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In the case of PA, as explained in Parliament on 17 August 2015, we have since taken steps to consolidate all 1,800 grassroots accounts into PA's financial statements to be in full compliance with the accounting standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And PA has since received an unqualified audit opinion since 2013.

sections.label: PA accounts consolidation and audit opinions
sections.summary: Before 2013 the accounts were not consolidated; after 2013 all 1,800 accounts were consolidated under PA and the accounts were unqualified.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: As I have clarified, before 2013, it was not consolidated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: After 2013, we have since taken steps to consolidate them, all 1,800 accounts under the PA accounts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: And we have not got a qualified account.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Unqualified accounts with observations and unqualified accounts without observations; and there is a material difference.
